description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds a JDBC datasource (quarkus-jdbc-h2, backed by
        Agroal) on top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Database Connection Pools panel light-up:
        the live Agroal pool configuration and AgroalDataSourceMetrics read by the QuarkusAgroalConnectionPoolProvider
        are mapped into the shared HikariPool* wire contract by the engine ConnectionPoolService, the JDBC URL /
        username are masked through the shared SecretMasker, and the panel is surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/database-connection-pools/pools (plus the per-pool /snapshot route). Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO datasource, so the AGROAL capability gate
        keeps the panel unavailable) so the datasource-present and datasource-absent paths are each proven in
        isolation — the same split used for the cache-present/absent and SmallRye-Health-present/absent coverage.
